question: Where are a café located within a 30 kilometers radius to the south of Novant Health & Vascular Institute - Elizabeth (Cardio), Charlotte, NC?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE amenity = 'cafe' AND ST_DWithin( pois.geometry::geography, ST_Project( (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Novant Health & Vascular Institute - Elizabeth (Cardio)%' LIMIT 1)::geography, 30000, -- 30 kilometers in meters radians(180) -- 180 degrees for South )::geography, 30000 -- 30 kilometers in meters );
